hypotheses.subject: Northvale.defence
hypotheses.why: A tired Northvale defensive unit would do fewer defensive sprints, making it easier for Harbour City to create more pressures in the opponent half.

hypotheses.subject: NV-09
hypotheses.why: Fatigue in Northvale's key CAM (NV-09) would lower his sprint speed, reducing his ability to carry or evade pressure and so increasing Harbour City's pressure events.
